nodes.title: How it works · bake first
widgets_values:
# Bake a reference bundle

1. Replace example.png with your own reference image and choose its matching VAE.
2. Choose the model family in Image RefMod Bake. Each bundle belongs to that family and VAE.
3. Queue once. The file is saved under models/refmods/<family>/example_character.safetensors.
4. Open the corresponding RefMod Apply example, refresh node definitions (R) if needed, and choose the saved bundle. The picker uses family/example_character, without .safetensors.

Overwrite is off. Enable it only when intentionally replacing an existing bundle. Connect image_2/image_3/image_4 for more references, within the selected family's limit.

## Family choices

Use this for Qwen 2.1, Fibo 2, Flux 3, Flux.2, Flux Kontext, MOSS or Krea 2. The default is MOSS-Image. Select the family BEFORE choosing the VAE. MOSS/Krea generation also needs a compatible edit LoRA. VAE choices: Qwen 2.1 uses qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16; Fibo 2, Flux 3 and Flux.2 use flux2-vae; MOSS uses flux2-vae_small; Kontext uses ae; Krea2 uses qwen_image_vae. At resolution=1024, Fibo 2 and Kontext follow their native trained image-size policies. Non-default resolutions are custom experiments. For LTX use RefMod_Bake_LTX_Guide.json, which matches guide dimensions to its video target.
